The historical facts are clear: Bedloe's Island was the former name of the island where the Statue of Liberty stands. It was officially renamed Liberty Island in 1956. Ellis Island is a separate island in New York Harbor that served as an immigration station.

The majority of agents are correct. Agent 1 appears to have confused two famous islands in New York Harbor.
